subtopic: Trump Account Investment Options and Contributions
source_evidence: All contributions will be invested in low cost mutual funds or ETFs that track broad U.S. equity indices (such as the S&P 500).
answer: Trump Account contributions are invested in low-cost mutual funds or ETFs that track broad U.S. equity indices, such as the S&P 500. Contributions are subject to an annual cap that is adjusted for inflation. In addition, U.S. citizens born from January 1, 2025, through December 31, 2028, receive a one-time $1,000 federal pilot program payment into their account.
